statement: >= 15 distinct organisations with a >= 1e26 FLOP run (shared with I-N-01; counted once per family) (Epoch AI; 2027-12-31)
counting_note: Per owner ruling 2026-11-17 (adjudications.md), I-R5-01 and I-N-01 are merged and I-N-01 is canonical. Items below mirror 2024/I-N-01.json (see duplicate_of) and must NOT be counted as separate evidence. All sources re-opened via web_extract on 2026-11-19; item 004 replaces I-N-01-004's unverified social-media source with a verified vendor press release (suggest updating I-N-01-004 to this source).
status_at_phase_end: Not met: 0 organisations with a public >= 1e26 FLOP estimate at end-2024 (largest ~5e25). A 100k-GPU cluster able to run 1e26-scale training was operating by Oct 2024 and being doubled, and a proposed reporting rule set its threshold at 1e26 operations, but no such run was public by year-end.

items.summary: Compute tracker: frontier training compute grows 4-5x/year; largest known runs ~2e25 and ~5e25 FLOP. Organisation count 0.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Training compute of frontier AI models grows by 4-5x per year' (re-verified this run).

items.summary: Compute tracker: ~2e29 FLOP runs likely feasible by 2030; implies many 1e26+ runs within a few years if trends hold, but not how many organisations.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Can AI scaling continue through 2030?' (re-verified this run).

items.summary: A Bloc A regulator proposed quarterly reporting for training runs above 1e26 operations, expecting it to apply to 'only a small number of entities'.
items.detail: Bloc A BIS proposed rule 89 FR 73612 (re-verified this run; the '0-15 companies' figure in I-N-01-005 was not located in the extracted text this run).

items.summary: The leading AI-chip vendor announced a Bloc A developer's 100,000-GPU cluster, described as the world's largest AI supercomputer, was training that developer's models and being doubled to 200,000 GPUs. Capacity for 1e26-scale runs existed; no such run public in 2024.
items.detail: NVIDIA press release on xAI Colossus (Memphis), 2024-10-28 (verified this run).
